question.prompt: What web start URL should these ORBITAL navigation tests open? The corpus names no runnable address for the dashboard.

options.label: Use {{start_url}}
options.detail: Keep the shared {{start_url}} placeholder in every web test and replace it at execution time.

options.label: Provide actual URL
options.detail: Supply the concrete ORBITAL dashboard URL to replace the placeholder in all tests.

options.label: Defer URL
options.detail: Leave the tests authored but not runnable until a web start URL is available.

content.risk_rationale: All seven tests are web-surface checks and cannot run until a start URL is supplied; the behavior design is grounded, but execution remains blocked without an entry point.
